description: Star Drift is a small canvas arcade game: steer a ship through falling debris, brake with Space, and chase a high score.
devlog: The first ship taught us restraint. A canvas, a scoreboard, and three buttons turned out to be enough for a real game, so nothing else was added. The debris falls a little faster the longer you survive, which keeps each run under a few minutes. Sound is synthesized in the browser and stays quiet until you ask for it.
pitch: Steer a small ship through falling debris and survive as long as you can.
title: Star Drift
